tail:
All 117 items were read, eight confirmed defects were repaired locally, and the mandated reflow/precheck checks pass on every changed item. The report is at `research/phase-2-remaining-27-reader-13.md` and the findings artifact at `research/phase-2-remaining-27-reader-findings-13.json`.

```json
{
  "batch": "13",
  "findings": [],
  "coverage_note": "All four assigned pages and all 117 assigned in-flight items were opened and read in full, with statements, titles, definitions, witnesses, contracts and citations checked against each item's own fact block; the numerical witnesses for su(2,1), sl(2,R), sl(3,R)/su(2,1) Vogan data, the Grassmannian frame model and hyperbolic space were recomputed rather than trusted. Eight confirmed defects in in-flight items were repaired locally (three sign/identity errors, one false chain in the global-Cartan differential argument, a false split-form clause and a false real-rank clause in a statement and step, two duplicated remark blocks, and a false convexity inequality in the maximal-compact-subgroup proof confirmed by an explicit Euclidean counterexample and replaced by the correct radius-function argument); reflow and precheck now pass on all eight. Limitations: I did not re-derive every case of the Borel-de Siebenthal enumeration or every exceptional entry of the two long classification items, which are cited to Knapp's Theorem 6.96/6.105 and Figures 6.2-6.3 (their statements, hypotheses, constructive steps and internal consistency were checked); I did not fetch and read the external source books page by page, so source locators were checked for internal plausibility only; ten load-bearing out-of-batch dependency statements were opened and read, the remaining dependencies only as quoted in the batch items' fact blocks; and the page files' requires lists were checked against the manifest, not audited as prerequisite closures. No uneditable defect was found, so the findings array is empty."
}
```
